fit: injected tarragon extract and mouse open-field distance
assessment: Figure 3 generally found unchanged travel, with a reduction at 100 mg/kg. An injected extract and aggregate exploration do not estimate gait speed after fresh tarragon in Parkinson’s.

fit: local pumpkin seed oil ultrasound and measured prostatitis pain
assessment: Mean pain fell 13.49 points with oil-coupled ultrasound and 12.59 with active ultrasound. The table supplies no pain-specific pairwise uncertainty. Local exposure and pelvic pain do not estimate clinical Parkinson effects of ingested cold-pressed oil.

fit: registered one-arm oral Cucurbita pepo oil pilot and pelvic pain/urgency composite
assessment: Manufacturer describes the named product as cold pressed. The registry records completion and 40 enrolled with no posted results. The composite is broader than pain alone and no Parkinson or oil-free comparison was assigned.

fit: developmental diets with engineered high-GLA canola oil vs borage and later maze behavior
assessment: Elevated-plus-maze performance showed no significant differences in male mouse offspring. The tested material and developmental design do not estimate the frozen Parkinson claim.

fit: fluoxetine plus rapeseed placebo in a three-arm major-depression trial
assessment: Nine of 16 analyzed participants in the fluoxetine plus rapeseed placebo arm reported anxiety, versus one with EPA and three with the combination. Concurrent drug differences prevent an oil-specific interpretation.

fit: optional canola within two Mediterranean diet arms and planned anxiety measures
assessment: The 2026 preliminary report supplies metabolic and adherence outcomes, with the planned anxiety comparison still open. Canola is an option within a diet bundle and oil pressing is unspecified.

fit: hydrogenated rapeseed excipient in active microalgae formulation and clinical GAD-7
assessment: Figure 6A gives no significant time or between-group anxiety effect in a low-baseline-anxiety sample. The recorded hydrogenated excipient varies along with the active microalgae compound and is not cold-pressed oil.

fit: black pepper essential oil facial cream versus unscented cream and home sleep staging
assessment: Thirty-two healthy adults used 0.0025% pepper oil or control at bedtime. Mean REM duration was 75.8 versus 72.4 min and no significant sleep differences were reported. There was no ground pepper ingestion or dream-enactment outcome.

fit: fresh and convectively dried red cabbage extracts and fibril-exposed cells
assessment: Extracts reduced alpha-synuclein-fibril-associated cytotoxicity in SH-SY5Y cells under some drying and exposure conditions. The study tested no cooked food intake or rigidity outcome.
